sections.title: Model selection, repeated search and overfitting

missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: US-0 partial: the planned extent 'Model selection, repeated search and overfitting' is only partly on the route. Repeated search (thm:p15-conc-selection-example), hold-out selection among K fixed candidates (thm:p15-conc-validation), per-hypothesis predetermined penalties (thm:p15-conc-weighted-learning, thm:p15-occam-weighted), data-dependent classes (thm:p15-occam-boundaries) and repeated inspection (thm:p15-conc-time-uniform) are present. Missing: (1) model selection across a family of candidate classes of different capacity, meaning choice of a class or complexity index with capacity-based penalties over nested finite or finite-VC classes, trading the approximation term of thm:p15-w02b-p15-064-decomposition against estimation error; (2) any cross-validation beyond a single hold-out split, such as k-fold or leave-one-out; (3) reuse of one validation set across adaptively chosen candidates, which is only flagged as uncovered at bounded-concentration-learning.tex lines 365-366 and is not treated. 'Overfitting' is never defined or named on these routes. The only illustration is the zero-error search example. All 29 unit components are covered.
